Plain words, with punctuation: commas, full stops; and a question?

Characters Markdown reads as syntax: \* stars \*, \_under_scores\_, \`ticks\`, \[brackets\], \<angle> and a back\\slash.

snake_case_names stay as they are, and so do 2\*3 and a \~ tilde.

\# not a heading

\- not a list item

1\. not a numbered item

\> not a quote

\+ not a list either

Entities stay text: \&amp; \&copy; \&#169; and a lone & ampersand.

Non-ASCII: café, naïve, 日本語, emoji 🚀, and a no-break space.
